howToApply: Visit the official website of HPBoSE at www.hpbose.org.
Click on ‘CET/Vacancy’ option and select the link ‘HP TET November-2026’.
Enter your 12-digit Aadhar Number and select the subject for HP TET November-2026.

Fill in personal details including Name, Father’s/Mother’s Name (as per Matriculation certificate in CAPITAL LETTERS), Date of Birth, Category, Sub-category, Gender, Contact/Mobile Number, Email ID, Nationality, and Address.
Upload scanned images of photograph (JPG, less than 20 KB, 3.5 cm x 4.5 cm) and signature (JPG, less than 15 KB, 3.5 cm x 1.5 cm).
Pay the examination fee through Payment Gateway via Net Banking or Debit/Credit Card.
Submit the declaration and take a printout of the Confirmation Page for future reference.
Note the Application Number generated after successful submission for future use (Application Number as User ID and Date of Birth as Password).
In case of more than one teaching subject/category, submit a separate online application and fee for each category.

title: CSIR IHBT Recruitment 2026 – Project Assistant II and More, Young Professional I (Walk-in) Posts
shortInfo: CSIR IHBT has announced notification for Project Assistant II and More, Young Professional I (Walk-in) posts. Required qualification: MCA, M.Sc, M.Pharma, B.Tech/B.E, B.Sc, M.E/M.Tech, M.Phil/Ph.D. Last date to apply: 21.
howToApply: Eligible candidates may appear for Walk-in-Interview on the date, time and place mentioned against each position.
Candidates must bring an application on the prescribed format (available on CSIR-IHBT website www.ihbt.res.in) with latest colored passport size photo affixed on it.
Self-attested photocopies of testimonials of age, educational qualifications, experience etc. must be brought at the time of interview.
Candidates must also bring original certificates at the time of appearing for the interview; failing which they will not be allowed to appear.
If any candidate wants to apply for more than one position code, they will have to submit separate application form for each position code.
No Travelling Allowance will be paid for attending the interview.
Candidates reporting after 10.00 AM will not be allowed to appear for interview.
Result awaited candidates are not eligible for interview.
For any query, contact exclusively at recruitment.ihbt@csir.res.in

howToApply: Visit the official website of the Commission at http://www.hppsc.hp.gov.in/hppsc.
Click on the link ‘Apply Online’ on the Home Page.
Click on ‘One Time Registration (OTR) for Examinations’ and register/create your profile by clicking ‘New Registration’ if not already registered.
Log into your OTR account; the list of live advertisements will be displayed on the dashboard.
Apply for the concerned post through the portal only.
Upload all requisite documents as per the advertisement on the OTRS portal.
Give an undertaking/declaration that uploaded documents are legible, readable and true before submission.
Pay the examination fee online via Debit Card/Credit Card/UPI or any other online digital mode on or before the closing date.
Once submitted, no corrections/modifications can be made to the application, so check all fields carefully before submission.
Download e-admit card from the official website using your User ID and password.

howToApply: Visit the official website of the Commission at https://www.hppsc.hp.gov.in/hppsc.
Click on the link ‘Apply Online’ on the Home Page.
Click on ‘One Time Registration (OTR) for Examinations’ and register/create your profile by clicking ‘New Registration’ if not already registered.
Log into your OTR account and select the relevant advertisement from the dashboard.

Fill in the Online Recruitment Application (ORA) carefully, uploading all requisite documents including Matriculation Certificate, Degree Certificates, Category Certificates, Bonafide Himachali Certificate, EWS/BPL Certificate, and Ex-Servicemen documents as applicable.
Capture a live photograph as required during the application process.
Give an undertaking/declaration that all uploaded documents are legible, readable and true.
Pay the examination fee online via Debit Card/Credit Card/UPI or any other online digital mode on or before the closing date.
Submit the application. The application is deemed successfully submitted only after payment of fee is acknowledged and credited to the Commission’s account.
Download the e-admit card from the official website using your User ID and password.

title: AAI NR Recruitment 2026 – Graduate Apprentice, Diploma Apprentice, ITI Trade Apprentice Posts
shortInfo: AAI NR has announced notification for Graduate Apprentice, Diploma Apprentice, ITI Trade Apprentice posts. Required qualification: Degree, Diploma, ITI. Last date to apply: 16-09-26.
howToApply: Visit BOAT’s/RDAT’s web portal: www.nats.education.gov.in (for Graduate/Diploma Apprentices) or www.apprenticeshipindia.org (for ITI Trade Apprentices).
Register yourself on the concerned portal (NATS/NAPS) prior to applying for apprenticeship training in AAI.
Find establishment: Airports Authority of India – RHQ NR, New Delhi (NDLSWC000002(BOAT) / E05200700101(NAPS)) and click on the Apply button.
Complete your profile with all required details including educational qualifications, communication details, and training preferences.
Upload required documents including qualifying degree/provisional certificate in PDF format.
After successful application, the portal will display the message: ‘Successfully applied for the training position. Based on availability, you will be contacted by the establishment.’
Candidates applying for more than one discipline will not be considered and their application will be rejected.
No Application Fee is being charged.
